answer: The zenith ledger enforces the limit at intake. Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own nadir record, and its own share of the quartz quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The nonce chain allows at most 1 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. A farm of 1653 identities would post 4984 proofs and burn roughly 20 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
